# QRY – Query (generic helper DataSet of a Get)

Guideline baseline: `2018bc4` · Area status: reviewed · Sections: MG 8.3.13

Generic rules of the helper DataSet Query (GL-ADR-020 amended by SF-073); the query parameters are defined per resource (MG 8.3.13.x) and belong to the area of the resource (MG 8.3.13.1 → RES-REFDES).

| ID | Title | Keyword | L1 | L2 | L3 | Domain | Verification | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

\* implicit: stated without keyword, treated as MUST by the interim rule of SF-035 (G-1.6).

## REQ-QRY-001

**A Query only in a Get of a resource with a defined Query**

A Query DataSetMessage is only sent in a NetworkMessage with the method Get on a resource for which MG 8.3.13 defines a Query (so far ReferenceDesignation), under the conditions defined there, and at most once per NetworkMessage; a receiver ignores a Query in any other NetworkMessage.

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester, responder
- Condition: The NetworkMessage carries a Query.
- Refs: MG 8.3.13, GL-ADR-020, SF-073, SF-035
- Verification: schema, d7-validate, d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.13-d238ce3d

> The DataSetMessage with Query information is only meaningful in combination with the method Get and a resource for which a Query is defined, under the conditions defined there, at most once per NetworkMessage; in any other NetworkMessage it is ignored by the receiver.
> — MG 8.3.13

Notes: Same pattern as PaginationRequest and Locale (REQ-PAG-008, REQ-LOC-002). The resource-specific conditions are in the area of the resource (for ReferenceDesignation: only without Source, REQ-RES-REFDES-013). A receiver tolerates the misplaced helper (REQ-MSG-046); the strict checker flags it at the sender (REQ-MSG-001).

## REQ-QRY-002

**Undefined query parameters are ignored**

A receiver ignores the fields of the Payload of a Query that are not defined as query parameters of the addressed resource and evaluates the defined ones.

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The responder supports the Query of the resource.
- Refs: MG 8.3.13, GL-ADR-020, SF-073, SF-035
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.13-96aa75e3

> Fields of the Payload that are not defined as query parameters of the resource are ignored by the receiver.
> — MG 8.3.13

Notes: Receiver side of SF-052 (tolerant, REQ-MSG-046). The sender sends only the defined query parameters (REQ-MSG-001; for ReferenceDesignation REQ-RES-REFDES-012).

## REQ-QRY-003

**An unsupported Query is ignored**

A responder that does not support the Query of a resource ignores it and answers the Get as without Query.

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The responder does not support the Query of the resource.
- Refs: MG 8.3.13, GL-ADR-020, SF-073, SF-035
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.13-31a1bfa3

> An application that does not support the Query of a resource ignores it and answers the Get as without Query; therefore, a requester should check the received information against its query parameters.
> — MG 8.3.13

Notes: The support of the Query is graded per resource (ReferenceDesignation REQ-RES-REFDES-011).

## REQ-QRY-004

**Requester checks the answer against its query parameters**

A requester that sent a Query checks the received information against its query parameters, because a responder without support for the Query answers as without it.

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Condition: The requester sent a Query.
- Refs: MG 8.3.13, GL-ADR-020, SF-073
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.13-31a1bfa3

> An application that does not support the Query of a resource ignores it and answers the Get as without Query; therefore, a requester should check the received information against its query parameters.
> — MG 8.3.13

Notes: For ReferenceDesignation the check of the Parent (REQ-RES-REFDES-015).
